card.name: Anti-VEGF eye and cancer drug text
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and digits inside dosing and section-number text for anti-VEGF drugs (aflibercept/EYLEA, bevacizumab/Avastin, pegaptanib). It fires on a space or digit right before a number such as 40 mg/mL or a section reference.

modes.label: Number gaps in EYLEA dosing
modes.description: A space or digit inside the intravitreal dose volume and concentration, just before 40 mg/mL.

modes.label: Avastin dose and section numbers

modes.label: Eye-injection drug lists
modes.description: Punctuation right after a brand name or date in a sentence about drugs injected into the eye.

card.writes: It seems to push toward name pieces like Chap and Admir, and away from imm and precision, so no clear drug-related effect.
